AutoCloseable, Closeable, edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable
All Known Subinterfaces:

    • close

      void close()
      Closes this instance immediately and performs locking-operations to ensure the complete closure of all hardware references. This renders any references to this instance unusable, and should essentially only be done when robot-code has finished operations.

      close in interface AutoCloseable

    • getReport

      Report<Measurement> getReport()
      Provides a full Report of the measurements of this Component from the last update(Report) cycle until now. If update(Report) has not been called for a significant amount of time, information may be stale, or out of date.
      Returns:
      Report of measurements

    • getConnection

      default Boolean getConnection()
      Provides the current status of connection to this instance's real-world hardware, if this robot is being simulated, then this should always be true, unless running Unit Tests.
      Returns:
      Status of connection to hardware

    • getTimestamps

      default List<Double> getTimestamps()
      Provides a list of all the timestamps at which measurements have been Reported during the last update(Report) cycle until now. This is most often sourced through a queue from a relevant OdometryThread updated asynchronously of the main-robot thread.
      Returns:
      Latest list of measurement timestamps

    • getMeasurement

      default Measurement getMeasurement()
      Provides the current measurement Reported during the last update(Report) cycle, which means it may be out-of-date if update(Report) has not been called for a significant amount of time.
      Returns:
      Latest Measurement

    • getMeasurements

      default List<Measurement> getMeasurements()
      Provides a list of all measurement (more specifically the different between the positions, deltas, in most cases) that have occurred from the last update(Report) cycle until now. This is most often sourced through a queue from a relevant OdometryThread updated asynchronously of the main-robot thread.
      Returns:
      Latest list of measurements
